/usr/bin/nvcc -forward-unknown-to-host-compiler -I/usr/include -L/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu -Wno-deprecated-gpu-targets -O3 -DNDEBUG "--generate-code=arch=compute_50,code=[compute_50,sm_50]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_52,code=[compute_52,sm_52]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_60,code=[compute_60,sm_60]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_61,code=[compute_61,sm_61]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_70,code=[compute_70,sm_70]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_72,code=[compute_72,sm_72]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_75,code=[compute_75,sm_75]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_80,code=[compute_80,sm_80]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_86,code=[compute_86,sm_86]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_87,code=[compute_87,sm_87]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_89,code=[compute_89,sm_89]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_90,code=[compute_90,sm_90]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_100,code=[compute_100,sm_100]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_101,code=[compute_101,sm_101]" "--generate-code=arch=compute_120,code=[compute_120,sm_120]" -Xlinker=--wrap=cudaLaunchKernel -Xlinker=--wrap=cudaMemcpyAsync -Xlinker=--wrap=cudaMemcpy -Xlinker=--wrap=cudaMalloc -Xlinker=--wrap=cudaFree -Xlinker=--wrap=cudaDeviceReset -Xcompiler=-fPIC -Wno-deprecated-gpu-targets -shared -dlink --options-file CMakeFiles/MonteCarloMultiGPU.dir/deviceObjects1.rsp -o CMakeFiles/MonteCarloMultiGPU.dir/cmake_device_link.o --options-file CMakeFiles/MonteCarloMultiGPU.dir/deviceLinkLibs.rsp
